flagged.evidence: P5 clause (iv) assigns the componentwise Hamiltonian H_op = -ħ²Δ/(2m) + V(Q), while P6 clause (ii) separately assigns the spin operators S_i = ħJ_i. In the allowed s=1/2, V=0 case, H_op is the free kinetic operator acting identically on the spin factor, whereas S_z has eigenvalues ±ħ/2. Those angular-momentum spectral values belong to S_z, not to the Hamiltonian's energy spectrum; P2 also defines sharp observables as separately assigned self-adjoint operators with declared units. Thus the unqualified statement that “energies, angular momenta and other spectral quantities belong to a specified model Hamiltonian” is false.
